subject: R Code for Detecting whether in Shiny (for knitR)

messages.author: 79bc9b51550aa74f
messages.subject: R Code for Detecting whether in Shiny (for knitR)
parts:
Hi everyone,

What I would like to do is write R code and render it
  • as an interactive shiny R markdown document
  • as a chapter of a LaTeX book
My current workflow plan looks like this:

R markdown document -> include R code as external sources -> render in shiny
Rnw latex -> include R code as external  -> run knitR/latexmk

So, basically, I would like to have just one source of R code which is reused. However, when I have an interactive component (renderPlot etc.), that does not work in Rnw files. Thus, my approach is something like:

if (IS_SHINY) {
  interactive code (renderPlot ...)
} else {
  standard code (simple plot)
}

What could I use as IS_SHINY? Something like is.null(input)?

Best wishes
Tobias

messages.author: 79bc9b51550aa74f
messages.subject: Re: R Code for Detecting whether in Shiny (for knitR)
parts: It should rather be exists("input"), not is.null(input)!
